title: From Class President to Data Science: Learning to Lead Through Evidence
summary: A reflection on how my experience as a sixth-grade class president changed my understanding of leadership. Initially relying on authority and rules, I learned to build trust by listening, gathering different perspectives, and making decisions based on evidence rather than assumptions. This experience also shaped my later interest in Data Science: the same habit of questioning first impressions, identifying missing information, and examining evidence became central to how I approach analytical problems.
